name: nexus-backend
description: NEXUS Cloud Functions for AI proxy, opportunity feed, and cohort intelligence

scripts.test:emulator: npm run build && cross-env FUNCTIONS_DISCOVERY_TIMEOUT=30 firebase emulators:exec --config ../firebase.json --project demo-nexus --only firestore,functions,auth "node --test test/emulator.integration.js"
scripts.serve: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --only functions
scripts.deploy: npm run build && firebase deploy --only functions
